On a repository's Issues page, use the landmark shortcut (D in NVDA browse mode) to jump to the filter region, then type a label name like good first issue in the Label filter field and press Enter to narrow results. speaker: ALEX
text: The practical takeaway is this. Is the description clear enough to act on? If you are not sure what the problem is, ask a clarifying question before starting work.
